title: Ice Knife
categories: Spells that gain benefits at higher levels
Spells that can be cast while silenced
html:
For the equivalent Way of the Four Elements Monk spell, see  Blade of Rime.
Ice Knife is a level 1 conjuration spell. It allows the caster to throw a shard of ice, which explodes and leaves behind an icy surface.

Description

Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10⁠⁠Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6⁠⁠Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an  Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.

This spell can be cast while you are  Silenced.

Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may fall Prone.

Type: Surface

Condition: Prone

 Prone

 DEX Save (Spell save DC)

  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.

Condition: Difficult Terrain

 Difficult Terrain
  • Movement Speed halved

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 1: Druid, Sorcerer, and Wizard
  • Class level 3: Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight
  • Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets)
  • Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets)
Granted by features:

Granted by items:

  • Frost Prince ( Recharge: Long rest)
  • Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves ( Recharge: Long rest)

Other ways to learn:

  • Wizards can transcribe a  Scroll of Ice Knife to their spellbooks.

Notes

  • Creatures on  Ice fall  Prone if they fail a Dexterity  Saving Throw.
